announcements.headline: Wereldhave Trading update Q3 2026
announcements.insight: Wereldhave issues a Q3 2026 trading update following its October asset disposal and executive appointment. Shareholders should monitor for financial details in this periodic report.

announcements.headline: Wereldhave sells Eggert Center in Purmerend to Transitions Europe, a French real estate investment fund, and retains asset management mandate
announcements.insight: Wereldhave disposes of Eggert Center to Transitions Europe while retaining the asset management mandate. This follows the earlier appointment of Remco Langewouters as Statutory Manager.

announcements.headline: Wereldhave announces the proposed appointment of Mr. Remco Langewouters as Statutory Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and convenes EGM
announcements.insight: Wereldhave appoints Remco Langewouters as Statutory Managing Director and CFO via EGM. This board change may influence future corporate governance and leadership direction.
